svg.title: Live research, one event at a time
svg.desc: An app name is typed into a search row. Research events appear one by one while a pixel map fills in, each pixel a claim marked verified, observed, inferred or unverified. Then the three forecast numbers appear.
svg.text: Search an app, or type one you’re not sure about
